authorization: ユーザーがシーン画と画風を承認し、同じ画風で人物画像の生成を依頼。
canonPolicy: 職業と本文の設定を参照。未記述の年齢・顔・髪・服装は今回の視覚デザイン案として保持し、世界の正史に自動追加しない。既存シーンの匿名人物には遡って名前を割り当てない。
framing: 縦長約2:3、一人の全身、3/4方向、顔と両足が読める、生成り紙の簡素な背景
reusableReferencePolicy: 次の人物入りシーンでは画風Bと、登場する人物の画像を別々の参照として添える。人物画像を顔・髪・衣服・道具の参照にし、背景やポーズまで固定しない。
commonPrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: a single full-length CHARACTER REFERENCE illustration for the original exploration game "Ash Estuary"; vertical portrait approximately 2:3, opaque background.
Input image 1 is the approved STYLE reference B, an existing environment illustration. Match its actual fine, irregular pen contours, restrained hatching, delicate watercolor washes, visible warm paper, realistic human proportions, softly observed materials and muted palette. Translate that exact drawing language to a large clearly readable person. The small anonymous people in the reference are NOT character identity references.
Composition: ONE person only, entire body from head to both boots, generous clean margin, subject about 80 percent of image height, eye-level three-quarter view. Clear individual face and silhouette; anatomically plausible visible hands, ordinary grounded posture. Sparse warm ivory paper background with a faint wash and just a suggestion of chalk paving at the feet. No elaborate environment, inset, second view, extra figure, frame, caption, labels or watermark.
Art direction: Quiet, beautiful coastal working life with restrained unease. Pale limestone ivory, slate and gray-blue, muted moss, weathered brown and small rust accents; soft overcast light. Hand-drawn pen and pale watercolor throughout, including the face. Avoid photographic or cinematic skin, glossy 3D, oil paint, anime, cartoon exaggeration, exaggerated black outlines, saturated colors or fashion glamour.
World invariants: Ordinary preindustrial coastal work clothes, practical repaired cloth, simple leather, wood and iron tools. No modern machinery, industrial uniform, fantasy armor, royal robes, weapons, heroic stance, glowing objects, magic, ghosts, readable memories, memory flashbacks, bodily corrosion or magical scars. These are living working people, capable and specific. This is a pre-choice reference portrait; do not depict any memory donation, choice result or hidden truth. Any record is closed or has indistinct marks only; no readable words or numbers.
